newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch.

text.p: * Technology shares were expected to continue to be volatile after yesterday's late selloff in the group. Losers were led by Intel, off 5-1/8 to 127-1/4 on Monday.

* Providian was seeking a buyer for its insurance operations, according to a Wall Street Journal report. The article said analysts list potential buyers as American General Corp and Conseco Inc. Providian shares were off 1/4 to 52.
* Musicland Stores said it would take an unspecified restructuring charge in the fourth quarter and close 18 Media Play stores after the first of the year. Shares were off 1/8 to 1-5/8.

* C-Cor Electronics says Q2 results will be below estimates and that it will cut 120 jobs, or 10 percent of its work force. The company cited upgrade delays by customers and shipment deferrals. Shares were off 7/8 to 14-1/8.
